annotation.bound_parties_text: The paper calls on countries (states), especially major countries, to act in specified ways; it is a non-binding position paper.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: In terms of strategic security, countries, especially major countries, need to develop and apply AI technology in the military field in a prudent and responsible manner
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Position Paper of the People's Republic of China on Regulating Military Applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) 2021-12-13 13:00
